subject: english
title: Let’s Talk 7–9 App — Showing Interest & Asking for Help
subtitle: Checkpoint after Units 7–9 · 6 modules: Ask About Words, Answer & React, Favorite Sport, Do you? — the echo game, What Does It Mean?, Can Leo Score?

content: Rebuild both Student Book dialogues line by line and say every line out loud.
Choose the right echo question for eight different sentences.
Match six real situations to the phrase that fits.
Answer comprehension questions on the two Activity 4 discussions.
language: Use the four ways of asking about a word, including Excuse me, Mr./Ms. ___.
Use Do you? · Wow. That’s so cool! · What about you?
Use I’m not sure. · No idea. · Um, I don’t think so.
Choose between Why don’t you…? and Why don’t we…? by who is stuck.
